snippet.title: Card Draw | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Card Draw Demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3261300?utm_source=yt_announcement_trailer

Card Draw is relaxing roguelike deckbuilder where you construct equations with your cards. 
Craft your strategy, build your deck, draw cards and create equations to produce points. 
Climb the leaderboards with your high score in multiple different game modes, or simply click, relax and watch big numbers go up.
